classification.difficultyReason: Use opposite-angle equality, sometimes after combining adjacent given sectors.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of the unknown angles.

spec.description: Intersecting straight lines, central dot, opposite acute-angle arcs, 48° at left and an empty rectangular handwriting box at right.
spec.mathematics: The opposite acute angles are equal. Directions are 24°, 156°, 204° and 336°.
spec.answerVisibility: 48° is a given; the opposite answer remains hidden.

answer.worked: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so the unknown angle is $48^\circ$.

spec.description: Horizontal and steep oblique straight lines with a central dot, four angle arcs, two given angles on the right and separate upper-left and lower-left rectangular boxes.
spec.mathematics: Upper-right 76.3°; lower-right 103.7°. Upper-left and lower-left are their respective opposite angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 76.3° and 103.7° on the right are supplied.

answer.worked: Vertically opposite angles are equal. The upper-left angle equals $103.7^\circ$, and the lower-left angle equals $76.3^\circ$.

spec.description: Perpendicular horizontal and vertical lines, central dot, upper-left and lower-right right-angle squares, upper-right and lower-left arcs and two empty boxes.
spec.mathematics: Both right-angle markers are retained. Each unknown is supplementary to a marked 90�� angle.

answer.worked: Angles on a straight line add to $180^\circ$. The upper-right angle is $180^\circ-90^\circ=90^\circ$. Its vertically opposite lower-left angle is also $90^\circ$.

spec.description: Intersecting horizontal and southwest–northeast lines, additional southeast ray, central dot, three arcs and an upper-left answer box.
spec.mathematics: The southeast ray partitions the lower-right 126° angle into 75° and 51°. The unknown is vertically opposite their combined angle.
spec.answerVisibility: 75° and 51° are givens; the upper-left response box is empty.

answer.worked: Vertically opposite angles are equal. The unknown angle is $75^\circ+51^\circ=126^\circ$.
